M.A.R.S. Companion LLC

Official Corporate Portal: https://company.teduza.com/
Wikidata Item: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141447626

M.A.R.S. Companion LLC is a technology company registered in Kapan, Republic of Armenia (Registration # 999.110.1603426, Tax ID: 09433977).
The company is developing M.A.R.S. Companion, a fully offline AI voice companion with long-term semantic memory, operating under license to 6 UK patent applications invented by Aleksandr Sarkisian.

Founder & Sole Developer
